meta.title: La Dolce Isola · Café, Wine Bar, Gelato in Scalea
meta.description: Bar, café, wine bar, gelateria and crêperie on the pedestrian street of Scalea. Open every day from 07:00 to 03:00. Browse the menu in six languages.

nav.home: La Dolce Isola, back to top

hero.sub: On the pedestrian street of Scalea, every day from 7 in the morning to 3 at night.
hero.posterAlt: The blue and white majolica tile with the La Dolce Isola script

teaser.title: Twenty-one pages to leaf through, as if at the table.
teaser.lead: The full menu in six languages, with prices and photos of the dishes.

blurb.cocktail-long-drinks: Spritz, mojito and the great classics.
blurb.gelato: Artisan gelato coppe, made to be looked at first.
blurb.selezione-vini: Whites, reds and rosés, many from Calabria.

about.title2: in the heart of the corso.
about.body: Sun-coloured walls, a walnut and marble counter, crystal chandeliers. Coffee and cornetti in the morning, artisan gelato and crêpes in the afternoon, Calabrian wines by the glass and cocktails under the umbrellas at night.
about.barAlt: The walnut bar counter with cream tufted panels and a marble top, yellow walls
about.wineAlt: The wine corner with shelves of bottles, a tufted table and the oval La Dolce Isola plaque
